title: ZCL-082, a boron-containing compound, induces apoptosis of non-Hodgkin's lymphoma via targeting p90 ribosomal S6 kinase 1/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Ma, Chunmin; Liu, Meng; Zhang, Jiong; Cai, Haiyan; Wu, Yunzhao; Zhang, Ying; Ji, Yanjie; Shan, Huizhuang; Zou, Zhihui; Yang, Li; Liu, Ligen; Xu, Hanzhang; Lei, Hu; Liu, Chuanxu; Zhou, Li; Cao, Yang; Zhou, Huchen; Wu, Yingli
one_liner_zh: 该文研究含硼化合物ZCL-082通过靶向RSK1/NF-kappaB通路诱导淋巴瘤凋亡，虽涉及p65 DNA结合和分子对接，但核心是药物抗肿瘤机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合预测，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Despite the rapid progress in the diagnosis and treatment, the prognosis of some types of non-Hodgkin's lymphoma (NHL), especially those with double-hit or double-expressor genotypes, remains poor. Novel targets and compounds are needed to improve the prognosis of NHL. METHODS: We investigated the effect of ZCL-082, a novel boron-containing compound with anti-proliferating activity against ovarian cancer cells, on NHL cells and human peripheral blood mononuclear cells by CCK-8 assay, Annexin V/PI double staining assay, RH123/PI double staining, Western blot, and immunohistochemistry. NF-kappaB pathway activity was analyzed using luciferase reporter gene assay and RT-PCR. The location of p65 was detected by immunofluorescence and nuclear/cytoplasmic fractionation assay. Immunoprecipitation and chromatin immunoprecipitation assays were used to detect the binding between p65 and p300. CETSA and molecular docking assay were carried out to test the interaction between ZCL-082 and p90 ribosomal S6 kinase 1 (RSK1). Kinase reaction was conducted to examine the inhibition of RSK1 kinase activity by ZCL-082. RESULTS: We found that ZCL-082 can induce the apoptosis of various NHL cell lines in vitro and in vivo. ZCL-082 significantly inhibits TNFalpha- or LPS-induced NF-kappaB activation without disturbing TNFalpha-induced IkappaBalpha degradation or the nuclear translocation and DNA-binding ability of p65. However, ZCL-082 markedly suppresses the phosphorylation of p65 on Ser536 and the interaction between p65 and p300. The overexpression of the phosphomimetic mutant of p65 at Ser536 partially abrogates ZCL-082-induced cell death. We further found that ZCL-082 directly binds to and inhibits the activity of RSK1. RSK1 can phosphorylate RelA/p65 on Ser536 and its overexpression is associated with the poor prognosis of lymphoma. The overexpression of RSK1 partially rescues ZCL-082-induced cell death. Molecular docking studies show that ZCL-082 fits well with the N-terminal kinase domain of RSK1. Furthermore, the combination of ZCL-082 and BCL-2 inhibitor ABT-199 has a synergistic apoptosis-inducing effect against double-hit lymphoma cell line OCI-Ly10. DISCUSSION: We found that ZCL-082 is a highly promising anti-lymphoma compound that targets RSK1 and interferes with the RSK1/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. The combination of ZCL-082 with BCL-2 inhibitor may represent a novel strategy to improve the outcome of double-hit or double-expressor lymphoma.
abstract_zh: 引言：尽管在诊断和治疗方面取得了快速进展，但某些类型的非霍奇金淋巴瘤（NHL），尤其是具有双重打击或双重表达基因型的患者，预后仍然不佳。需要新的靶点和化合物来改善NHL的预后。方法：我们通过CCK-8实验、Annexin V/PI双染实验、RH123/PI双染、Western blot和免疫组化方法，研究了一种新型含硼化合物ZCL-082（对卵巢癌细胞具有抗增殖活性）对NHL细胞和人外周血单个核细胞的影响。使用荧光素酶报告基因实验和RT-PCR分析NF-kappaB通路活性。通过免疫荧光和核/质分离实验检测p65的定位。使用免疫沉淀和染色质免疫沉淀实验检测p65与p300之间的结合。采用CETSA和分子对接实验测试ZCL-082与p90核糖体S6激酶1（RSK1）之间的相互作用。进行激酶反应以检测ZCL-082对RSK1激酶活性的抑制。结果：我们发现ZCL-082在体外和体内均可诱导多种NHL细胞系的凋亡。ZCL-082显著抑制TNFalpha或LPS诱导的NF-kappaB激活，而不干扰TNFalpha诱导的IkappaBalpha降解或p65的核转位及DNA结合能力。然而，ZCL-082显著抑制p65在Ser536位点的磷酸化以及p65与p300之间的相互作用。p65在Ser536位点的磷酸化模拟突变体的过表达部分消除了ZCL-082诱导的细胞死亡。我们进一步发现ZCL-082直接结合并抑制RSK1的活性。RSK1可以磷酸化RelA/p65在Ser536位点，其过表达与淋巴瘤的不良预后相关。RSK1的过表达部分拯救了ZCL-082诱导的细胞死亡。分子对接研究表明，ZCL-082与RSK1的N端激酶结构域良好匹配。此外，ZCL-082与BCL-2抑制剂ABT-199的联合使用对双重打击淋巴瘤细胞系OCI-Ly10具有协同诱导凋亡的作用。讨论：我们发现ZCL-082是一种极具前景的抗淋巴瘤化合物，靶向RSK1并干扰RSK1/NF-kappaB信号通路。ZCL-082与BCL-2抑制剂的联合使用可能代表一种改善双重打击或双重表达淋巴瘤预后的新策略。
